Name: Dinora
Overview:
BUILD, MINE, FIGHT, EXPLORE and PROCREATE in your own world of Dinora.

Brave it alone or share the experience with up to 3 friends in drop-in/drop-out split screen multiplayer. Hours and hours of fun in one unforgettable sandbox adventure.

If you liked Terraria you’ll love Dinora, with its unique spin on NPC interaction.
